name: RepoQA
intro: RepoQA是一个旨在评估大型语言模型（LLMs）长上下文代码理解能力的基准测试。它通过“搜索针函数”（SNF）任务来挑战LLMs，要求模型根据自然语言描述搜索代码函数，这需要模型深入理解代码和描述。RepoQA是多语言且全面的，包含从50个流行代码库中收集的500个代码搜索任务，涵盖5种现代编程语言。
org: University of Washington, Google, ETH Zurich
build_method: 仓库筛选, 依赖拓扑分析, 针函数抽样, GPT-4-Turbo 描述标注
metric: 检索准确率（目标平滑 BLEU 最高且 > 0.8）
scale: 500个任务（50个仓库 × 每仓库10个；5种语言）
build_method_en: Repository Selection, Dependency Topology Analysis, Needle Sampling, GPT-4-Turbo Description Annotation
intro_en: RepoQA is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' (LLMs) long-context code understanding ability. It challenges LLMs with the "Search Needle Function" (SNF) task, requiring models to search for code functions based on natural language descriptions, demanding deep comprehension of both code and descriptions. RepoQA is multilingual and comprehensive, containing 500 code search tasks collected from 50 popular code repositories, covering 5 modern programming languages.
metric_en: Retrieval Accuracy (target has highest smoothed BLEU and > 0.8)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.06025 and the official EvalPlus RepoQA repository. The benchmark selects 50 repositories, ten each in Python, C++, Java, TypeScript, and Rust, requiring topic diversity, unit tests or CI/CD, and at least 100 stars. Main-package files are dependency ordered, concatenated, and divided into 64 chunks; the first uniquely named function under 2,000 bytes from each eligible chunk forms the candidate pool, from which ten needles are sampled per repository. GPT-4-Turbo writes four-part descriptions while hiding function and variable names. Each 16k context places ten needles at 10%-100% depths. Tree-sitter extracts the first syntactically valid block, then smoothed BLEU compares it with every context function; retrieval succeeds only when the target ranks first and exceeds 0.8. Results report overall and per-language accuracy, with an optional comment-free comparison.
